Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of a Glasswright, a tall slender living alien of soft flesh that grows glass inside its body. Its long neck, throat, shoulders and hands are soft milky translucent living flesh like the body of a jellyfish, faintly pulsing, with pale pink strands of sinew and muscle visible inside; fine threads of clear glass and small faceted crystal inlays are grown into the flesh in flowing lines like veins, and light runs along the glass threads like fibre optics and splits into rainbow colours where it leaves the crystal inlays. Its head is a tall faceted crystal shape like a long rough-cut gemstone growing out of the top of the soft neck; its front is one large blank polished facet, gently curved and uneven like natural crystal, with glowing colour moving deep inside. The milky flesh and pink sinew of the neck climb up over the lower edges of the crystal and between its lower facets, so there is no rim or seam, and small crystals continue in rows down the back of the neck. It wears a layered robe of crystal plates and silver mirror-thread fabric, open at the throat. This is Saro of Long Focus, a Glasswright lance-master: one long-fingered hand holds up a large clear lens that focuses a thin white beam of light to a burning point, the beam splitting into a rainbow fringe. Painted grimdark science-fiction character portrait, oil painting with visible loose brushstrokes and palette-knife texture, dramatic chiaroscuro, square composition. Pose and framing: facing the viewer, holding up a clear lens at arm's length to one side that focuses a thin white beam, half-body. Setting: a dark observatory with a huge lens array overhead, painterly and softly out of focus behind the subject. Key light: the bright beam itself, from the side; deep shadow elsewhere; muted desaturated palette of clear crystal, silver and white light splitting into faint rainbow fringes. Museum-quality concept art for a dark space-opera strategy game. No text, no letters, no logo, no border, no frame, no watermark.
